description: This file implements WebSocket protocol handling, including frame encoding/decoding, request/response key generation, and managing WebSocket frames within a WebSocketLink class in the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket protocol specifics such as key generation, frame encoding, and decoding.

methods.name: Protocol::RequestKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket request key by creating random bytes and encoding them.

methods.name: Protocol::ResponseKey
methods.description: Calculates the WebSocket response key based on the request key and the WebSocket handshake magic string.

methods.name: Protocol::Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data into WebSocket frames, handling masking, frame types, and fragmentation.

methods.name: Protocol::Decoder
methods.description: Decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handling unmasking, frame validation, and reassembly.
